description: List a remote MCP server you operate in the Koskamo MCP directory, in two calls. A call without token validates the server fields and returns a claim token plus where it can be published (/.well-known/koskamo-claim on the endpoint host, or TXT _koskamo-claim.<domain>). A call with id and token looks for that proof and runs a live check; when both pass, the listing is published and an owner key is returned once. Nothing is listed without both. Method "email" with proofEmail at admin, administrator, webmaster, hostmaster, postmaster on the endpoint's domain is the alternative to DNS or web proof: a single-use confirm link is mailed there, its token is not returned, and verification succeeds after a person presses Confirm. An optional contact email is used for notices about auto-hide, a lapsed proof, or key recovery; it receives one confirmation message and nothing else until confirmed, and it does not grant ownership.

companyUrl.description: Optional https company website; an empty string clears it on edits

description.description: 20-600 characters, factual; required on the first call

docsUrl.description: Your documentation page for this server; required on the first call

email.description: Optional contact address for listing notices

endpoint.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint (https); required on the first call

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case page id, e.g. acme-docs

method.description: First call: "email" (with proofEmail) mails a confirm link instead of a token to publish. Verify call: limits the check to this proof method; an email proof requires "email"

name.description: Product name; required on the first call

operator.description: Company that runs the server; required on the first call

proofEmail.description: First call with method "email": admin|administrator|webmaster|hostmaster|postmaster@<endpoint host or a parent domain>, no plus-tags. A person must open the mailed link and press Confirm before verify succeeds

requirements.description: Optional; up to 4 prerequisites a user must already have (e.g. a vendor account or paid subscription), beyond endpoint sign-in

token.description: The claim token from the first call; verifies the proof and publishes the listing

tools.description: Optional; replaced by the live tool list when the check passes

useCases.description: 1-6 use cases from your documentation; required on the first call

name: koskamo_register_mcp_server
title: Register an MCP server
